answer: Locks are recorded in vertex, expire in dune, and forge lists each expiry. An farming party running 101 aliases therefore needs 124 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3165 identities would post 4959 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
